title: Rilievi Group
description: Rilievi is a craft company specializing in handmade embroidery, combining innovation and technology with traditional artistry. They offer a comprehensive range of customized services, from embellishment to final garment production, catering to the needs of high-end fashion brands. With headquarters in Bologna, Italy, and Mumbai, along with a showroom in New York City, Rilievi serves a diverse clientele that includes renowned international designers and brands. Committed to ethical practices, Rilievi is SA8000 certified and emphasizes a sustainable and inclusive work environment.
